digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and CI routing
propositions: Documentation-only Gerrit changes currently consume the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, and identity jobs; a trusted classifier must route changes with only allowlisted documentation paths to a reduced docs-only Verify lane while retaining all documentation gates.

The routing classifier and complete allowlist must execute only from trusted origin/main; the untrusted patchset supplies only the exact change diff (HEAD^..HEAD), and any classifier failure or uncertainty must select the full Verify fallback while also blocking Verified.

Documentation-related gates (ADR validation, index/cross-reference checks, quickstart validation, drift detection, DCO identity, and criteria checks) must be extracted into a single shared composite action reused by both full and docs-only lanes without adding a new runner job.

The docs-only Verify lane must skip the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs, while preserving all documentation validation and vote aggregation fail-closed semantics.

The classifier route decision and docs-only job results must be wired through vote.needs so that classifier failure blocks Verified, full-route fallback runs when classifier fails or produces route=full, and exactly one route executes per patchset.

Every existing structural test consumer of gerrit-verify.yaml (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, and others) must be preflight-migrated to follow the extracted shared action without losing assertions, and check_verify_gate_parity.py must validate that docs-only gates cannot be omitted from vote aggregation.
